name: Haunted Plate Mail
description: Well-crafted armor in the Gavish castle crypt with a darkness inside its visor.

timeline.summary: Borico seeks the crypt's coolness and stands before a suit of armor with an unlit darkness in the visor.
timeline.quote: He stood in awe in front of a particularly well-crafted suit of armor.

timeline.summary: In the story, the brother rises as a fearless spirit in the armor, slays the necromancer, and rests in the crypt.
timeline.quote: the noble ghost charged into the necromancer's castle and slew him
